title: Sovereign home — hero + live KPIs
description: The public landing page. Editorial navy/gold hero with a Libre Baskerville headline, three live KPI cards (Notices Published, Suppliers Approved, Work Packages), and three primary CTAs — View Open Notices, Register as Supplier, and the Portal Gateways link.

title: Public notice board
description: The reverse-chronological list of every published notice. Fuzzy search, country/category filters, deadline chips and per-row EMD hints. This is the primary discovery surface for prospective bidders.

title: Live tenders listing
description: All tenders currently open for bidding. Same card structure as the notice board with a countdown chip on each card driving urgency.

title: Completed tenders
description: Public archive of every tender that has passed its submission deadline. Awards, final prices and winning bidders are shown once the award is finalised and cleared for publication.

title: All tenders — unified archive
description: The combined live + completed archive with a status filter. Used by researchers, auditors, and inbound partners doing due diligence on PMC.

title: About Us — company narrative
description: Editorial About page. Charter, milestones, leadership grid, sector coverage, and press quotes. All copy is content-managed via the notice-board CMS.

title: Vision & Mission
description: The strategic doctrine page — Vision, Mission, Values, and the North-Star KPIs the platform is optimised for. Used in tender-committee briefings.

title: Supplier registration — start
description: Public entry point for vendor self-onboarding. Email, company name, country. A magic link is dispatched via Resend and the bidder resumes the deep intake wizard from that link.

title: Sovereign Gateway — 5-portal picker
description: Five distinct credentials safeguard PMC. Selecting a card reveals a portal-specific credential form (per-role colour + badge).

title: Admin portal — credential form
description: The System Administrator portal — colours default to editorial slate + amber badge. Root-level control of the platform: user provisioning, master catalog, audit.

title: Management portal — credential form
description: The PMC Management portal — executive dashboards, committee outcomes and escrow-level financials.

title: Strategic Partners portal — credential form
description: For GOC / Bank / Regulator personas — bank-guarantee verification, regulatory audit hooks, co-procurement dashboards.

title: Procurement Agents portal — credential form
description: Field-ops portal for procurement agents drafting tenders, reviewing bidder dossiers, publishing corrigenda and verifying BOQ line items.

title: Registered Vendors portal — credential form
description: Bidder portal — purchase tender packs, submit digital bids, join live reverse auctions, sign contracts. Gold-accented CTA.

title: Admin console landing (Operations Overview)
description: First screen after admin login — collapsible sidebar grouped into Overview / Procurement / Market / Money & Compliance / Events, environment chip, AI Copilot shortcut.

title: Admin · Audit trail
description: Immutable action log with entity filters.

title: Admin · Notices — publish & manage
description: Create, publish, edit, withdraw, attach documents, EMD.

title: Admin · Tender Builder & DPR AI
description: Master library, DPR deep-dive, AI Fill All, PDF export.

title: Admin · Work packages
description: Modular deliverable packages for the KZ programme.

title: Admin · Vendor directory
description: Full CRUD on suppliers, licences, compliance, tenants.

title: Admin · Vendor intel & ratings
description: Trust badges, moderation, criteria averages.

title: Admin · Escrow / EMD desk
description: EMD receipts, forfeitures, refunds.

title: Admin · Evaluation & scoring
description: Technical + financial scoring, QCBS, L1 comparison, envelope locking.

title: Admin · Awards & POs
description: Letters of award, POs, contract award workflow.

title: Admin · Roles & permissions
description: Fine-grained ACL matrix.

title: Admin · Reverse auctions
description: Live auction rooms, invitations, spectator link.

title: Admin · Masters — fees, roles, EMD
description: Fee slabs, staff roles, criteria, categories, countries.

title: Vendor landing (post-login)
description: Vendor dashboard immediately after sign-in. Header shows company + trust badges; body shows open tenders, held EMDs, active auctions.

title: Vendor · Open tenders
description: Tenders the vendor may bid on, filtered to declared categories.

title: Vendor · My bids
description: Every submitted bid with envelope status, score summary and award outcome.

title: Vendor · Ratings received
description: Reviews left by admins post-contract with an aggregate trust badge.

title: Vendor · Contract signatures
description: DocuSign envelopes pending / signed by the vendor.
